items.title: Offline claim recomputation and figure build
items.reason: Recomputes reported values and figures without network, model, or evaluator calls.

items.title: SGE estimators, analyzers, and auditors
items.reason: Provides inspectable offline implementation support while the main paper carries the claims; historical live executor prototypes are intentionally excluded.

items.title: Trace-to-reference-DAG annotation contract
items.reason: Makes semantic DAG construction and adjudication inspectable.

items.title: Reviewer-safe derived evidence
items.reason: Contains the minimum derived rows and compact summaries needed for offline checks; raw restricted families are excluded.

items.title: Strict invalid-pair evidence
items.reason: Preserves P007 and P018 failures and null paired metrics to prevent selective reporting.

items.title: Privacy and restricted-material audit
items.reason: Records path/account sanitization and verifies exclusion of credentials and raw runtime evidence.

items.title: Evidence-governed figure contract and accessibility audit
items.reason: Pins figure sources and evidence boundaries and declares geometry, font, vector, and accessibility checks.
